lines: Settled 79° at 4:32PM, in 78° to 79°. The noon lean was 80° to 81° at 85% — missed (forecast 80.7, off by 1.7°).
The market agreed at noon (80° to 81° at 54%) and both were wrong.

The high was set at 4:32PM — after the 1:51 PM six-hour group; the hourly reports topped out at 78°, 1° under the settlement — a peak between reports that the 5-minute feed or a corroborated TWC maximum would have seen.
Lesson: the runs ran warm by 1.7°; the recency-weighted bias window pulls that in from tomorrow.
